text:
alex: Hey infra team — we need a ceiling bump in a new region I'm prepping (ap-northeast-10). Target families: p4d, p5, g5. This is for a mixed training + inference pilot for a partner; want to reserve enough to run 6 p5s (64GB), 4 p4ds, and 12 g5s concurrently across 3 AZs. Also need ENI and instance-per-account limits raised, and permission for EFA-enabled placement groups.

priya: Do you have the breakdown by AZ and expected start date? AWS is more likely to approve with concrete AZ distribution and a biz justification.

alex: Planned start 2026-06-12. AZ spread: ap-northeast-10a/ap-northeast-10b/ap-northeast-10c, desired distribution p5:[2,2,2], p4d:[1,2,1], g5:[4,4,4] (total counts above). Justification: partner pilot (3 months) migrating from spot-heavy fleet to reserved burst capacity; latency-sensitive inference needs dedicated infer nodes. Cost center: INFRA-EVAL.

jamie: Add notes about networking limits — request bump for ENIs per region by +200, IPs per ENI default, and raise NAT gateway SNAT pool by +50 for initial ramp. Also call out EFA and placement group limits.

alex: Filed support case with AWS: case 0-1234-5678 (subject: "ap-northeast-10 accelerator + networking capacity request"). Pasted the template below we used:

```
Subject: Request increase of GPU instance quotas and ENI limits in ap-northeast-10
Customer: Redwood Inference — INFRA-EVAL
Requested start date: 2026-06-12
Instances: p5:6, p4d:4, g5:12 across 3 AZs (detailed distribution attached)
Networking: ENI +200, NAT SNAT +50, allow EFA and placement-group limits for HPC traffic
Reason: Pilot for partner inference+training workloads; production SLA targets; required for capacity planning and placement validation
Contact: alex@redwood.ai, priya@redwood.ai
```

infra-bot: AWS support case created: 0-1234-5678. ETA for initial response ~48 hrs. Reaction: :thumbsup:.

priya: Also flag to cost team: rough burn estimate ~ $3.2k/hr peak if fully provisioned (we won't run at peak continuously). Can we pre-approve a temporary budget spike?

jamie: I'll DM finance and create a temporary billing alert. Also checking if we should request a smaller pilot first (reduce to 50% counts) to speed approval.

alex: Thanks — keeping the larger ask in case AWS can greenlight it. If they want a phased approach we'll accept fallback to a 50% pilot. Will update thread when support responds.
